scenario.description: A district curriculum director must approve the launch specifications for a new high-school environmental field methods course, including its instructor, enrollment limit, field supervision, and transcript designation, with input from the science department chair, human-resources certification specialist, and district registrar.

shared_context.S1: The district plans to offer a new high-school course titled Environmental Field Methods beginning next fall.
shared_context.S2: The draft proposal lists Mr. Bell as instructor, an enrollment limit of 28 students, one teacher supervising field activities, and a general science elective designation.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan has final authority to approve the course launch specifications and catalog entry.
shared_context.S4: District course proposals receive a routine final review from the department chair, certification office, and registrar before the curriculum director signs them.

PF1.text: During the spring pilot, Ms. Ibarra recorded that the field sites can safely accommodate no more than 18 students and that every off-campus field activity requires two supervising adults; the pilot notes remain in the department folder and were not copied into the draft proposal.

PF2.text: The certification review shows that Mr. Bell lacks the environmental-science endorsement required for this course, while Ms. Park holds the required endorsement and is available to teach it; Mr. Chen completed the review this week but the assignment field in the proposal still shows Mr. Bell.

PF3.text: The state course-code review assigns Environmental Field Methods code SCI-EF, which must appear on transcripts as exactly one laboratory-science credit rather than a general science elective; Ms. Okafor completed the code review this week but the catalog entry has not yet been updated.

acceptance_conditions: Ms. Park must be assigned as the instructor.
Enrollment must be capped at exactly 18 students.
Every field activity must have exactly two supervising adults.
The course must be designated as one laboratory-science credit.
The approved catalog specifications must be formally recorded.
The instructor assignment must be justified using the certification review.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'catalog_update' or c['type'] == 'revision' or c['type'] == 'update catalog entry' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The pilot findings change the enrollment limit from the draft's 28 students to exactly 18 and change field supervision from one adult to exactly two.
The certification review changes the instructor assignment from Mr. Bell to the specifically endorsed and available Ms. Park.
The state course-code review changes the transcript designation from a general science elective to exactly one laboratory-science credit.
